ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of the _ day of Ju~, 2003, by and between by and between KIWI REALTY LLC ("Owner"), a New York limited liability company, having an address at 165 West 73rd Street, New York, New York 10023, and THE TRUSTEES OF COLUMBIA UNIVERSITY IN THE CITY OF NEW YORK ("Developer"), a New York non-profit corporation, having an address at 412 Low Memorial Library, 535 West 116th Street, New York, New York 10027. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lot 42 in Block 1875 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 220 West 104th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described in Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land"; the building(s) located thereon is herein referred to as the “Owner Building"; and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the “Owner Parcel"); WHEREAS, Developer is the fee owner of certain land, with the buildings and York, known as Lot 18 in Block 1875 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street address 213-223West 103rd Street a/k/a 2692-2704Broadway,NewYork,NewYork, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Developer Land") the building and improvements thereon are herein referred to as the “Existing Developer Building"); WHEREAS, Developer has previously purchased the excess development rights appurtenant to the land located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of New York, known as Lots 40 and 41 in Block 1875 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, and as and by the street addresses 216 and 218 West 104th Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit “B-1" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land is herein referred to as the “Air Rights Parcel"); WHEREAS,Developer intends toenlarge or add additional floors to theExisting Developer Building, and to construct other improvements associated with such enlargement or additional floors (the Existing Developer Building and such enlargement or additional floors, together with anyadditionstheretoorfuturealterations theretoor replacements thereof not "Developer Building"; and the Developer Land and the Developer Building are herein collectively referred to as the“Developer Parcel"); 2 KL3:2241847.5 z0/, /3-,

WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less floor area, as defined in the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), than is now available for use on the Owner Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, so that the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer to and utilization on the Developer Parcel and any Additional Parcel (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the Developer Building will contain more floor area (as hereinafter defined) than is now available for use on the Developer Parcel pursuant to the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), and the parties hereto therefore desire to utilize the procedure available pursuant to the Zoning Resolution for the Merged Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) so as to make available the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction and maintenance of the Developer Building, and Owner is willing to make such Excess Development Rights available to Developer in perpetuity; WHEREAS, Owner desires to retain the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, the parties hereto are simultaneously herewith executing (i) a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term“zoning lot” in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution in order to create a single zoning lot of the Owner Parcel, the Air Rights Parcel and the Developer Parcel (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged in accordance with the Declaration and the terms of this Agreement, is herein referred to as the “Merged Zoning Lot"), and (ii) such other agreements, easements and licenses as are necessary to effectuate the intent of the parties in connection with the Excess Development Rights (the Declaration and such other agreements, easements and licenses are herein collectively referred to as the “Zoning Documents"); WHEREAS,Owner desires toutilize theRetainedDevelopment Rights(as hereinafter defined) for the construction of an Additional Floor (as hereinafter defined), which, when constructed, shall be deemed part of the Owner Building; WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect NOW THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby conclusively acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 3 KL3:2241847.5
